headline: Blackstone (BX) Q2 Profit Jump Shows AI Is Starting To Pay Off
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) reported a strong Q2 profit surge linked to AI related investments. Management highlighted contributions from AI exposure across its private equity, private credit, and real estate units. Infrastructure holdings and fresh inflows into the private equity business were cited as key areas of outperformance.
